slides.title: Most goals per game
slides.description: Goals scored, averaged over fixtures that were actually played.

slides.title: Fewest goals conceded per game
slides.description: Opponent goals, averaged over fixtures that were actually played.

slides.title: Most interceptions
slides.description: Opponent passes reached first by this team's defenders.

slides.title: Most shots blocked
slides.description: Goal-bound strikes whose next touch came from a defender.

slides.title: Most tackles won
slides.description: Challenges that ended with possession changing to the defending team.

slides.title: Most dribbles
slides.description: Touches where the same player carried and collected the ball again.

slides.title: Longest dribble distance
slides.description: Ball travel while being carried, measured in pitch units.

slides.title: Most completed passes
slides.description: Passes that reached a different player on the same team.

slides.title: Longest passing distance
slides.description: Ground covered by completed passes, measured in pitch units.

slides.title: Most shots
slides.description: Struck kicks whose direction carried the ball toward the goal mouth.

slides.title: Most time on the ball
slides.description: Share of played ticks with the ball at a player's feet: inside control range and moving with it.

slides.title: Most attacking territory
slides.description: Share of played ticks with the ball in the opponent's half.

slides.title: Fewest fouls per game
slides.description: Kickoff encroachments: stepping inside the centre circle while the other side was taking a restart, which sends the offender to the touchline.
